bullets: Removed Crouton Alpha from the free model picker.
Added Beam 1.0 to the Standard section of the free model picker.
Stronger AI models no longer receive the solo session discount and are charged at their full rate.
Auto-names new desktop projects using the first message you send.
Shows a specific message when a custom domain is unavailable.
Reserves half the context window for output when using your own model service.
Displays recently used folders in the web interface without revealing local paths.
Shows a Git status snapshot including branch and merge readiness.
Uses your GitHub account to read pull request details when the desktop tool is unavailable.
Added an archived filter and chat count to the cloud project listing.
